s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and disconnect the harness from terminal C.
Remove the 2 screws and remove the repair service starter kit from the starter motor terminal kit.
Pull the plunger and remove it from the drive lever pin.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Starter Commutator End Frame Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts, and remove the starter yoke assembly w/ starter commutator end frame assembly from the starter motor terminal kit.
Remove the starter yoke assembly from the starter commutator end frame assembly.
Remove the starter armature plate from the starter yoke assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Starter Commutator End Frame Cover

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, remove the starter commutator end frame cover from the starter commutator end frame assembly.
Secure the starter commutator end frame assembly with aluminum plates in between.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the starter commutator end frame assembly.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the snap ring, and remove the starter armature assembly and washer from the starter commutator end frame assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the starter armature assembly.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 starter planetary gears from the starter motor terminal kit.
